subject: Model improvement exclusion toggle + export / SLA confirmation
messages:
From: Anne Carter <anne.carter@brightleaf.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.example.com>
Cc: security@brightleaf.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: model-improvement-exclusion toggle + export and SLA confirmation

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — BrightLeaf is close to deciding but we have two gating items from procurement/security before legal signs:

1) A toggle in the product or API that ensures BrightLeaf data will not be used for model improvement by Redwood (we'd like a firm operational description of how that toggle works and evidence it was applied for our tenant).
2) A guaranteed export path for logs/prompt-response pairs and an SLA for delivery (we need to ingest into our secure environment).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Provide an immediate toggle we can enable at tenancy level (not just a contractual promise).
- Generate an export with structure and retention metadata, and provide dates for a one-time export and periodic exports (if applicable).
- Provide audit evidence that the toggle was active for a given time window (e.g., an attestable audit entry or signed statement).

Also, procurement asked for a short addendum to the DPA capturing the exclusion for model improvement and an exhibit describing the export format. If possible, we would like a DocuSign-ready addendum.

Can you share a proposed timeline for implementation (we are targeting contract signature by next Friday 2025-07-11)?

Best,
Anne Carter
CISO, BrightLeaf Health
--
Anne Carter | BrightLeaf Health
security@brightleaf.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.example.com>
To: Anne Carter <anne.carter@brightleaf.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.example.com, marissa.cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: model-improvement-exclusion toggle + export and SLA confirmation

Anne — thanks for the clear list. High-level confirmation first: yes, Redwood supports a tenancy-level model-improvement-exclusion (we normally call it a 'no-model-improvement' flag) that is enforced in the serving runtime and recorded in audit logs.

Plan & next steps (short):
- Ops & Engineering (cc: Dev) will provide the technical description of the toggle, where it is applied (control plane + serving runtime routing), and expected evidence artifacts (audit entry format).
- I will coordinate a sample export (schema + sample payload) and a one-time export timeline. For periodic exports we can offer a weekly export for the first 30 days and then monthly; we can make frequency part of the addendum if that helps.
- Legal (cc: Marissa) will prepare a one-page DPA addendum (model-improvement exclusion + export exhibit) and a DocuSign-ready envelope.

Tentative timeline:
- Technical spec + audit sample: EOD Thu 2025-07-03
- Sample export and playbook (with file names & retention metadata): Fri 2025-07-04
- Draft DPA addendum for review: Mon 2025-07-07
- DocuSign-ready addendum: Tue 2025-07-08

If those dates work for BrightLeaf we can hit your signing target. I'll also include an ops checklist for export SLA and a stub of the audit entry we will attach.

Logan Wright
Senior Privacy & Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.example.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.example.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.example.com, anne.carter@brightleaf.com
Date: Thu, 03 Jul 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: model-improvement-exclusion toggle + export and SLA confirmation

Logan / Anne — quick technical note and attachment.

What the toggle does (short):
- When tenancy flag 'no_model_improvement' = true, incoming user data is routed to standard inference path but the telemetry pipeline that feeds model-improvement training buckets is bypassed.
- We persist an immutable audit record: {timestamp, tenant_id, flag_set_by, control_plane_tx_id, applied_nodes}.
- The serving runtime also emits a per-request header X-Redwood-Transcript-Tagged: no-improve when the flag is active.

Attachments: export_process.pdf (playbook + sample file names and schema).

Export SLA options we can support:
- One-time export: delivered within 3 business days after request (SFTP/HTTPS pull or AWS S3 transfer).
- Weekly automated exports: available for first 30 days; thereafter monthly unless contract modifies frequency.

We can produce a signed attestation (signed by ops lead) that the flag was active across a given window; the attestation will include the audit entries and a hash of the export package.

Dev Patel
Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: export_process.pdf)
From: Anne Carter <anne.carter@brightleaf.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.example.com>
Cc: security@brightleaf.com
Date: Thu, 03 Jul 2025 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: model-improvement-exclusion toggle + export and SLA confirmation

Thanks — this all looks promising. Two follow-ups:
- Can you confirm the attestation format will include the control_plane_tx_id and a hash of the exported package? Our audit team requires an integrity hash for ingestion.
- For one-time export, we prefer SFTP into our secure intake; can you confirm you support SFTP with per-transfer encryption and a retention manifest?

Procurement will want to see the DPA addendum language before they approve the frequency (weekly vs monthly). Could Marissa send a short draft by Monday?

If you can provide the sample export and the attestation hash by EOD Fri we can keep to our internal schedule.

Anne
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Anne Carter <anne.carter@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.example.com>, dev.patel@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 04 Jul 2025 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: DPA addendum draft + export checklist (DocuSign link)

Anne — attaching the DPA addendum draft (dpa_addendum_v2.pdf) and a short export checklist. Highlights:
- Clause 4.3: Tenant may elect 'no model improvement' at tenancy level; Redwood will implement the flag in production within 24 hours and provide attestations for the requested window.
- Exhibit A: Export format (CSV/NDJSON samples) and retention metadata.
- Exhibit B: Operational steps for SFTP transfer and integrity hash (SHA256).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/BRIGHTLEAF-DPA-ADDENDUM-2025
Export playbook (internal): https://drive.redwood.example.com/brightleaf/export-playbook

We propose: one-time export in 3 business days; weekly exports for 30 days by default. Frequency can be tightened in the addendum if BrightLeaf requires it.

If that aligns I will prepare the DocuSign envelope for signature.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: dpa_addendum_v2.pdf)
